en.commentary: The Crucial P510 takes first place at 9.1, and the arithmetic is the entire argument. On the Coolpc price list this morning, 6 September 2026, the 2TB P510 sits at NT$9,500. That is NT$4,750 per terabyte for a PCIe 5.0 drive with genuine TLC flash. On the same list, on the same day, the 2TB WD_BLACK SN8100 is NT$20,500, or NT$10,250 per terabyte. One shop, one morning, the same capacity, and a terabyte costs 2.2 times as much depending on which box you pick up. I rank by price per terabyte because in 2026 that is the number that moved, and it moved further than any other spec on the shelf. Here is what pushed it. Phison's chief executive confirmed that TLC 1-terabit NAND contract pricing climbed from $4.80 to $10.70 in six months, that essentially all of 2026 production is already committed, and that the pressure runs through 2027. TrendForce has third-quarter 2026 NAND contract prices rising another 10 to 15 percent quarter on quarter and notes that consumer buyers have reached their affordability limit. AI datacentre demand is taking the wafers, enterprise drives are absorbing close to half of global NAND bit shipments, and consumer parts get what is left. The second thing to understand is that the model number on the box has stopped being a promise. Samsung shipped a 990 in 2026 that reads 7,250 MB/s and writes 6,450 MB/s with 850K random read IOPS, sitting alongside a 990 PRO rated at 7,450 and 6,900 with 1,400K. The 990 launched at $530 for 2TB, which is more than the 990 PRO cost at its own 2022 launch. Buyers who pattern-match on the family name will pay more for less throughput. The precedent goes back further: in 2020 and 2021 Adata shipped the XPG SX8200 Pro with a changed controller and changed NAND under an unchanged model number and unchanged spec sheet, and Tom's Hardware measured a 41 percent drop in file-copy performance on the revised units. So I score every drive on where its NAND actually comes from, and I favour drives sold by the companies that own the fab. Micron sells Crucial, Kioxia sells EXCERIA, Samsung sells Samsung, and YMTC sells ZhiTai. When the fab owner puts its own name on the retail box, the flash inside is traceable and the revision history is public. On buy or wait: buy. Supply relief arrives in 2027, contract prices are still climbing this quarter, and every month you wait costs you roughly the discount you were hoping to find.

highlights.title: The Crucial P510 at NT$4,750 per terabyte is the drive I would buy with my own money
highlights.body: NT$9,500 for 2TB of PCIe 5.0 with TLC flash is the cleanest deal on the Taiwanese shelf right now. It reads 11,000 MB/s and writes 9,500 MB/s, which saturates any Gen5 game load you will realistically throw at it, and it comes from Micron's own fab so you know exactly whose flash you bought. The trade you accept is the HMB design, which borrows system RAM for its mapping table, so very long sequential writes settle down to native flash speed once the SLC cache fills. For a boot drive, a game library, or a photo archive, that ceiling never gets touched. Spend the NT$11,000 you saved against an SN8100 on something you will actually notice.

highlights.title: Buy from the company that owns the fab, because there are only five or six of them
highlights.body: Samsung, SK hynix with Solidigm, Kioxia, Micron, and YMTC produce essentially all of the world's NAND wafers, and more than fifty brands sell drives built from that output. Four of those producers put their own name on retail drives, and those are the four I rank at the top: Crucial is Micron, EXCERIA is Kioxia, ZhiTai is YMTC, and Samsung is Samsung. Buying from the fab owner gives you a traceable flash source, a published revision history, and a warranty backed by the company that made the cells. It also explains the price spread on this page, because a brand that buys wafers on the open market in 2026 is paying the same contract prices that doubled in six months, then adding its own margin on top.

highlights.title: The Samsung 990 PRO with a heatsink costs NT$3,000 less than the bare one, and I checked it three times
highlights.body: Coolpc lists the bare 2TB 990 PRO at NT$16,999 and the heatsink version at NT$13,999 this morning. Same controller, same V-NAND, same 7,450 MB/s rating, and the one with more metal on it is cheaper. This happens because the two SKUs draw on separate import batches with separate landed costs, and in a market moving this fast nobody bothers to reconcile them. It is worth checking on every drive you shortlist, because the SKU-level spread inside a single model is now wide enough to change which drive is the better buy. Grab the heatsink version, pull the heatsink off if your motherboard already has one, and keep the NT$3,000.

highlights.title: Waiting for prices to fall is the one strategy that reliably loses money this year
highlights.body: Phison has told the market that 2026 output is committed and that pricing pressure extends through 2027. TrendForce has NAND contract prices up another 10 to 15 percent this quarter. New fab capacity is scheduled for late 2027 at the earliest. Put those three together and the expected value of waiting six months is negative: you pay more, and you spend six months on the drive you already have. If you need storage, buy the capacity you need today at the best price per terabyte you can find, and make it a single 2TB drive, because on this page 2TB is consistently the cheaper tier per terabyte.

zh-tw.commentary:
第一名我給 Crucial P510，9.1 分，理由用一行算式就講完了。今天 2026 年 9 月 6 日，原價屋掛牌 P510 2TB 是 NT$9,500，換算下來每 TB NT$4,750，而且是有真 TLC 顆粒的 PCIe 5.0。同一張報價單、同一個早上，WD_BLACK SN8100 2TB 掛 NT$20,500，每 TB NT$10,250。同一家店同一天同樣容量，你手伸向哪個盒子，一 TB 的成本就差 2.2 倍。

我用每 TB 售價排名，因為 2026 年真正在動的就是這個數字，而且它動的幅度比規格表上任何一欄都大。

講一下為什麼會這樣。群聯執行長已經公開講明，TLC 1Tb 的 NAND 合約價半年內從 4.8 美元漲到 10.7 美元，2026 年的產能幾乎全部被預訂走，壓力會一路延續到 2027 年。TrendForce 則預估 2026 年第三季 NAND 合約價還要再季增 10% 到 15%，同時直白地寫說消費端買家已經到了負擔上限。AI 資料中心把晶圓吃走，企業級 SSD 吞掉接近一半的全球 NAND 位元出貨，剩下的才輪到我們這些自己組機的。

第二件你一定要知道的事：盒子上的型號現在已經不能當承諾看。三星 2026 年推出的 990，讀 7,250、寫 6,450、隨機讀取 85 萬 IOPS，旁邊擺的 990 PRO 是 7,450、6,900、140 萬 IOPS。而 990 的 2TB 上市價 530 美元，比 990 PRO 自己在 2022 年上市時還貴。看到家族名稱就直接下單的人，會用更高的價格換到更低的效能。

這種事其實有前例。2020 到 2021 年，威剛的 XPG SX8200 Pro 在型號和規格表都沒改的情況下換掉主控和顆粒，Tom's Hardware 實測改版後的檔案複製效能掉了 41%。這件事發生在五、六年前，但它建立的規矩到今天還在用。

所以我給每一顆打分數時，都會看它的 NAND 到底出自誰家，而且我明顯偏好由晶圓廠自己掛名販售的產品。美光賣 Crucial，鎧俠賣 EXCERIA，三星賣三星，長江存儲賣致態。晶圓廠把自己的名字印在零售盒上時，裡面是哪批顆粒查得到，改版紀錄也是公開的。

最後是該買還是該等：買。供給要到 2027 年才會鬆，這一季的合約價還在往上走，你多等一個月，付出的金額大概就等於你原本想省下的那個折扣。

highlights.title: 每 TB NT$4,750 的 Crucial P510，是我會自己掏錢買的那一顆
highlights.body:
NT$9,500 買到 2TB 的 PCIe 5.0 加真 TLC 顆粒，這是現在台灣貨架上最乾淨的一筆帳。讀 11,000、寫 9,500，你實際會遇到的 Gen5 遊戲載入場景它都吃得下，而且顆粒直接出自美光自家晶圓廠，你買到誰家的 NAND 一清二楚。

它的取捨在 HMB 設計，靠系統記憶體當快取，所以 SLC 快取寫滿之後，超長時間的連續寫入會掉回原生顆粒速度。當開機碟、遊戲庫、相片備份，這個天花板你一輩子碰不到。

跟 SN8100 比省下來的那一萬一，拿去換你真的感覺得到的東西比較實在。

highlights.title: 買晶圓廠自己掛名的，因為全世界就只有五、六家在做 NAND
highlights.body:
三星、SK 海力士（含 Solidigm）、鎧俠、美光、長江存儲，全球的 NAND 晶圓基本上就這幾家產，而市面上掛牌賣 SSD 的品牌超過五十個。這五、六家裡有四家自己掛名做零售，而我排在前面的正好就是這四家：Crucial 是美光、EXCERIA 是鎧俠、致態是長江存儲、三星就是三星。

跟晶圓廠買的好處很具體，顆粒來源查得到、改版紀錄是公開的、保固由親手做出這些記憶胞的公司扛。

這也解釋了這頁的價差為什麼拉這麼開。2026 年在公開市場買晶圓的品牌，付的就是那個半年翻倍的合約價，然後再往上加自己的毛利。

highlights.title: 三星 990 PRO 含散熱片版本比裸卡便宜三千，我看了三次確認過
highlights.body:
今天早上原價屋的掛牌，990 PRO 2TB 裸卡 NT$16,999，含散熱片版本 NT$13,999。同一顆主控、同樣的 V-NAND、同樣標 7,450 MB/s，多一塊金屬的那個反而便宜三千。

會這樣是因為這兩個料號走的是不同批進口，落地成本各自算，而在這種波動速度下沒人有空回頭把價格對齊。

這件事值得你在每一顆候選上都查一次，因為同一個型號底下不同料號的價差，現在已經大到會直接改變哪一顆才是划算的選擇。

我的做法是直接拿含散熱片的那個，主機板本來就有散熱片的話把它拆掉就好，三千塊留在自己口袋裡。

highlights.title: 今年最穩定會賠錢的策略，就是等降價
highlights.body:
群聯已經對市場講明 2026 年的產能被訂光，價格壓力延續到 2027。TrendForce 預估這一季 NAND 合約價還要再漲 10% 到 15%。新增晶圓產能最快也要 2027 年下半才會開出來。

這三件事擺在一起，等半年的期望值是負的，你會付更多錢，而且這半年你還是在用手上那顆舊硬碟。

真的需要空間就今天買，挑每 TB 最便宜的那個級距下手。另外一個具體建議是直接上 2TB，這頁的每一個品牌都是 2TB 那一階的每 TB 單價最低。

en.commentary:
TrendForce now forecasts NAND flash contract prices rising a further ten to fifteen percent quarter over quarter in Q3 2026, on top of increases that already took consumer 1TB drives from roughly forty five dollars in late 2025 to close to ninety dollars. I built this ranking around price per terabyte and spec stability for exactly this reason, and the forecast confirms the ordering.

The Crucial P510 stays first because Micron controls its own NAND supply. When contract prices rise, a drive built on captive fab output holds its retail price better than a drive assembled from purchased flash. That is the whole argument for the nandSource factor, and 2026 has been an extended proof of it.

Kioxia Exceria Plus G4 at 9.0 sits second on the same logic with the added benefit of consistently good sustained write performance under long transfers. If you move large video files, this is the one I would test first.

What I want readers to internalise is that the relief point has moved. Industry consensus put consumer price easing at the end of 2026 earlier this year, and that expectation is now pushed to 2027. Buying advice follows directly from that. If you need a drive in the next twelve months, buying now costs less than waiting, and that is an unusual thing for me to say about storage.

One more note on spec stability. Several vendors have quietly changed the NAND inside drives that kept the same model number. I score specStability heavily because a review of a drive you cannot actually buy is worthless, and the drives at the top of this list have held their configuration.

highlights.title: Captive NAND supply is why Crucial holds the top spot
highlights.body: Micron manufactures the flash inside the Crucial P510. During a period when NAND contract prices are forecast to climb another ten to fifteen percent this quarter, a drive built on in house fab output holds its shelf price better than one assembled from flash bought on the open market. That structural advantage is the reason I built a nandSource scoring factor at all, and 2026 has been an extended demonstration of why it belongs here.

highlights.title: Price relief has moved from late 2026 to 2027
highlights.body: Earlier this year the industry expected consumer storage prices to ease at the end of 2026. That expectation has been pushed back a full year, with capacity reallocated toward high bandwidth memory for AI datacentres. This is a structural reallocation of wafer capacity, so it does not self correct on the usual cycle. If you need a drive within twelve months, buying today costs less than waiting, and I do not often say that about storage.

highlights.title: Kioxia Exceria Plus G4 is the pick for sustained large transfers
highlights.body: The Exceria Plus G4 holds its write speed through long transfers instead of falling off a cliff once the cache fills, which is the behaviour that matters when you are moving hours of video off a card. At 9.0 it sits a tenth behind the P510 on overall value, and for editors moving large files daily I would test it first. The gap between them is small enough that availability at your retailer should decide it.

highlights.title: Check the NAND inside the model number before you buy
highlights.body: Several vendors have changed the flash inside drives while keeping the same model number and box art. That practice makes a positive review worthless if the drive you receive uses different memory. I weight spec stability heavily because of it, and the drives at the top of this ranking have held their configuration through the shortage. Look up the specific revision code on the label before you commit.

zh-tw.commentary:
TrendForce 現在預估 NAND 快閃記憶體合約價在 2026 年第三季還要再季增百分之十到十五，而這是疊加在消費級 1TB 硬碟已經從 2025 年底約 45 美元漲到接近 90 美元之上的。我當初就是為了這個把這份排行榜建立在每 TB 價格與規格穩定性上，這份預估印證了排序。

Crucial P510 守住第一，因為美光自己掌握 NAND 供給。合約價上漲的時候，用自家晶圓廠產出蓋的硬碟，零售價撐得比用外購快閃顆粒組裝的硬碟穩。這就是 nandSource 這個評分因子的全部論據，而 2026 年整年都在證明它。

Kioxia Exceria Plus G4 的 9.0 排第二，邏輯相同，另外多了長時間傳輸下持續寫入表現穩定的好處。你如果常搬大型影片檔，這是我會先測的一支。

我希望讀者記住的是，價格緩解的時間點往後移了。今年稍早業界共識把消費端價格緩解訂在 2026 年底，這個預期現在推到 2027 年。購買建議直接從這裡導出。如果你未來十二個月內需要一支硬碟，現在買比等下去便宜，而這種話我很少對儲存裝置說。

再補一點規格穩定性。好幾家廠商悄悄換掉了型號沒變的硬碟裡面的 NAND。我把 specStability 權重壓得重，因為一篇評測如果對應的是你買不到的那個版本就毫無價值，而這份清單最上面幾支硬碟的配置一直沒變。

highlights.title: 自有 NAND 供給是 Crucial 守住第一的原因
highlights.body: Crucial P510 裡面的快閃顆粒是美光自己做的。在 NAND 合約價本季預計再漲百分之十到十五的期間，用自家晶圓廠產出蓋的硬碟，貨架價撐得比在公開市場買顆粒組裝的穩。這個結構性優勢就是我當初設 nandSource 這個評分因子的原因，2026 年整年都在示範它為什麼該留在這裡。

highlights.title: 價格緩解從 2026 年底延後到 2027 年
highlights.body: 今年稍早業界預期消費端儲存價格會在 2026 年底緩解。這個預期已經整整往後推了一年，產能被重新配置給 AI 資料中心用的高頻寬記憶體。這是晶圓產能的結構性重分配，所以它不會照往常的循環自己修正。十二個月內需要硬碟的人，今天買比等便宜，而這種話我對儲存裝置很少說。

Crucial P510 holds first at 9.1 and the ranking carries forward. I have spent the last few weeks on price and timing, so today I want to settle the hardware question readers ask me most in this market: is PCIe 5.0 worth paying for, or does a PCIe 4.0 drive do the job?

For a gaming PC or a general desktop, a fast PCIe 4.0 drive or an efficient entry PCIe 5.0 drive covers everything. Game loading depends mostly on random read performance and on how well the game engine streams assets, and the difference between a good Gen4 drive and a flagship Gen5 drive in load times is a second or two in most titles. That is why my top four all score between 8.0 and 9.6 on random I/O while posting 9.0 or better on price per terabyte. The P510 is a DRAM-less PCIe 5.0 design that runs cool, with an 8.8 thermal score, and that makes it an easy fit in a motherboard slot under a hot graphics card.

A flagship Gen5 drive earns its price in one situation: large sustained writes. If you copy multi-hundred-gigabyte video projects, move virtual machine images or cache large AI model files, sustained write after the cache fills is the number you feel. The Crucial T710 scores 9.4 there with 9.4 random I/O, and the Samsung 9100 PRO posts 9.2 and 9.6. Those drives shorten a real workday for the people who need them.

With NAND pricing still elevated, that distinction is worth money. A flagship Gen5 2TB drive costs noticeably more per terabyte than the P510 or the KIOXIA EXCERIA PLUS G4, and for a player that premium buys very little you would ever notice. Spend it on capacity. A 2TB P510 that holds your full library does more for daily use than a faster 1TB drive that forces you to uninstall games.

zh-tw.commentary: Crucial P510 2TB繼續排第一，這個月鬧得沸沸揚揚的NAND快閃記憶體短缺，反而讓它的地位更穩固。合約NAND價格從二零二五年底到現在大概已經漲了四倍左右，產業分析師現在預期消費者要等到二零二七年才會看到真正的價格緩解，今年不會有。P510在這波短缺全面爆發之前就已經把價格定得很有競爭力，PCIe Gen5控制器跟持續寫入表現，在市場轉向之前就已經是同級最強，現在入手的買家拿到的是一顆真正靠實力設計出來排第一的硬碟，這個名次禁得起時間考驗。KIOXIA EXCERIA PLUS G4守住第二名，靠的是KIOXIA自己掌握NAND晶圓製造，這讓它在這波短缺裡，價格穩定度比要向外採購快閃記憶體的品牌好很多。SK hynix Platinum P51能守住第三名也是同樣的結構性理由，今年垂直整合NAND供應鏈的重要性，比任何一項跑分數字都更關鍵。這次我沒有調整任何名次。考慮到NAND價格的走向，我的建議是，現在就下手，不要等一個可信的產業預測都認為二零二七年前不會出現的降價，優先選擇像Crucial、KIOXIA、SK hynix這種垂直整合NAND製造的品牌，它們的供應鏈最不容易受到後續漲價衝擊。

highlights.title: 不要等二零二六年降價，因為預測根本沒有這個跡象
highlights.body: 持續追蹤NAND短缺的產業分析師，現在把消費者能感受到的價格緩解時間點放在二零二七年，今年基本上不會出現。與其苦等一個可信預測都不看好的折扣，現在就把定價合理的硬碟買下來更划算。

en.commentary:
Crucial P510 2TB holds first, and the way I weigh it this week is through the retail price of a 2TB drive. Coverage this month puts a 2TB NVMe at $300 to $480, where the same class sat around $120 to $150 a year ago. In that market, the P510's 9.6 price-per-terabyte score and 9.2 Taiwan availability score carry real weight, because a drive you can find at a fair price beats a faster one sitting out of stock.

KIOXIA EXCERIA PLUS G4 stays second with a 9.8 NAND source score and a 9.5 thermals score, which makes it my pick for a cool, predictable system drive in a small case. SK hynix Platinum P51 takes third on a 9.6 random IO score and 8.6 sustained write, the best mix here for boot times and app launches that feel instant.

One thing I keep telling readers is to read the spec stability score. Controllers and flash can change between production runs, and the drives that score 9.2 and above there, like the KIOXIA, give me the most confidence that the unit in your box behaves like the unit that was reviewed. With prices this elevated, a wrong pick costs more than it used to, so I would rather you buy once and buy right.

I am leaving every rank where it is. The price trackers expect only gradual easing over several quarters, and none of the top three has given me a reason to reshuffle.

zh-tw.commentary:
Crucial P510 2TB 繼續第一，這週我用 2TB 的實際售價來衡量它。本月的報導指出，2TB NVMe 現在落在 300 到 480 美元，同等級的產品一年前大約是 120 到 150 美元。在這種行情下，P510 的每 TB 價格 9.6 分和台灣供貨 9.2 分格外重要，畢竟買得到、價格合理的硬碟，比一顆缺貨的快槍實用多了。

KIOXIA EXCERIA PLUS G4 維持第二，NAND 來源 9.8、散熱 9.5，放在小機殼裡當系統碟，溫度穩定又好預測，我自己很愛這種個性。SK hynix Platinum P51 排第三，隨機 IO 9.6、持續寫入 8.6，開機和開程式的體感特別跳，前三名裡屬它最俐落。

我常跟讀者說，一定要看規格穩定度這個分數。控制器和快閃顆粒在不同批次可能換料，像 KIOXIA 這種在規格穩定度拿到 9.2 以上的，我比較放心你手上那顆跟評測那顆表現一致。現在價格墊高，買錯一次的代價也變高，所以我寧願你一次買對。

這次名次全部不動。價格追蹤資料預期幾季內才會慢慢緩和，前三名也沒有出現需要調整的理由。

highlights.body: 散熱 9.5、NAND 來源 9.8，適合小機殼與長時間穩定負載。

highlights.title: P51 體感最俐落
highlights.body: 隨機 IO 9.6 讓開機與開程式的速度感在前三名裡最明顯。

highlights.title: 規格穩定度要看
highlights.body: 2TB 動輒 300 到 480 美元，規格穩定度 9.2 是保護這筆預算的保險。
